<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Centaur Weapon Familiarity](/Feats.aspx?ID=5323) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Centaur" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=747" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 31

</column>

---

You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster. You have familiarity with the [lance](/Weapons.aspx?ID=383), [longbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=436), [longspear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=361), [shortbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=437), and [spear](/Weapons.aspx?ID=365)—for the purposes of proficiency, you treat any of these that are martial weapons as simple weapons.

 At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with one of these weapons, you get its [critical specialization effect](/Rules.aspx?ID=235).
name: Centaur Weapon Familiarity
